sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.market_ticker IN ('KXRT-RES-93','KXRT-RES-94','KXBIGGESTQUAKE-17SEP26-7.0','KXBIGGESTQUAKE-17SEP26-6.8') THEN 'PINNED(live book)' ELSE 'rest of shadow' END AS grp, count(DISTINCT o.market_ticker)::text AS markets, count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.outcome='both_filled')::text AS both_filled, count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.outcome LIKE 'partial_both%')::text AS partial_both, count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.outcome<>'neither_filled')::text AS n_one_or_better, round((count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.outcome='both_filled')::numeric / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.outcome<>'neither_filled'),0)),4)::text AS p_both_given_one FROM incentive_shadow_outcomes o WHERE o.fill_model='conservative' AND o.placed_at > now() - interval '14 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
